analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: Helps us understand which tools and settings people use, so we know what to improve. Never includes the text of your scripts.

necessary.label: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Makes the tools work the way you asked them to, like keeping the script you wrote. These stay on your device and are never sent to us.

_ga.purpose: A random ID that lets Google Analytics tell a returning browser apart from a new one.

_ga_*.purpose: Lets Google Analytics group the pages you view into a single visit.

privacy:consent.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected analytics, so we don't ask on every page.

tp:hintSeen.purpose: Remembers that you've closed a tip, so it doesn't keep coming back.

tp:script.purpose: Keeps the script you wrote in your browser, so it's still there when you come back.

tp:settings:v1.purpose: Remembers how you set up the teleprompter, such as font, text size and colours.
